provenance.capture: Real synthetic T0 runner producer output; exact JSON projection from experiment.json without changing values. All decoded-node digest maps are retained complete, including native telemetry copies; migration base content_digests is retained as the observed null.
provenance.trimmed: All unlisted experiment fields, including settings, camera poses, traces and trace paths, frame/pass metrics, screenshots, source/binary receipts, queue/counter telemetry other than content_digests, and other payload_behavior fields. Complete migration drawn_counts are retained for the captured jitter regression. No digest nodes or draw records were sampled, normalized, or synthesized.

content_reference_sources.chunk: prepared GSQ page-directory decoded digest, bound by the verified manifest digest set
content_reference_sources.hlod: independent prepare/W13 reopened V4 node digests from the tree sidecar
content_reference_sources.scope: per-route page/node content against preparation; no exact cross-route partition correspondence
